blocks.h:
I ran this one
end to end.
p: Leadership handed me the StudioLive Series III SE launch as a trial run for an Art Director promotion: my chance to own a global campaign from the first pitch to the final export.

I wasn't a one-man band, but I was the one accountable for the vision. I pitched the concept to leadership, wrote the storyboards, directed the shoots, oversaw the edit and sound design, shot the photography, and when we needed a mixer on camera, I stepped in as the talent too.

cards: Pitched the campaign idea to leadership and built the creative brief that greenlit production.
Conception, storyboards, visual direction, on-camera talent, and editing oversight.
Directed a full LED volume wall virtual production alongside a traditional soundstage shoot.
Sound design and soundtrack sourcing from a Fender recording artist.
High-end transactional product shots plus elevated, stylized campaign studio imagery.
Social carousels, dealer infographics, and web wireframing support across the rollout.

p: The SE line lives in two worlds at once: the meticulous control room and the unforgiving live stage. The creative platform had to hold both, cinematic and moody but engineered and precise. I storyboarded a film that moved from an abstract, texture-driven world into the real hands, rooms, and crowds the console actually serves.

items: One deck, one story: prove that a boutique creative vision could ship at flagship scale. Leadership greenlit the full production off that pitch.
Every setup, camera move, and cut was drawn before we rolled. The storyboards became the shared language across crew, talent, and post.

blocks.sub: I wrote and drew the shot-by-shot boards that set the film's pacing and framing, the reference every department shot against.

blocks.title: StudioLive Series III SE · Official Launch

blocks.p: We built the hero world in-camera on an LED volume wall, real-time environments wrapping the talent and the console, then paired it with a traditional soundstage shoot for the precision product moments. I directed both, cutting between the cinematic and the clinical without ever breaking the look.

p: Two photo languages, shot and art-directed by me: clean, catalog-grade product detail for e-commerce and dealers, and stylized campaign imagery to carry the brand story.

items: Campaign · the SE family, SE 16 / SE 24 / SE 32

p: To prove the range of the line, I extended the campaign into real rooms: tracking sessions in Nashville home studios and worship services in San Antonio churches, capturing the SE consoles in the hands of the people who'd actually own them.

blocks.h:
The launch didn't
stop at launch day.
p: A pro-audio flagship lives or dies on proof. Engineers, worship techs, and studio owners don't buy from a spec sheet. They buy from seeing the console work in rooms like theirs. So I built the social rollout as a system: a launch-week core to command attention, then a recurring series to keep the SE in the feed long after the announcement.

The insight: the SE audience researches gear on YouTube and Instagram, not brochures. The job wasn't to describe a mixer. It was to make a deep, technical feature set legible and scroll-stopping, then keep showing up after the launch spike faded.

blocks.sub: Four content pieces, one idea, cut for how each surface actually behaves.
items: The attention-grab at the top of the funnel.
The full SE story made legible, swipe by swipe.
The proof layer for buyers who go deep.
content pieces, one idea, cut per surface

recurring series built to outlast launch week

blocks.lede: Launch spikes fade. So the team built SOUNDCHECK, a recurring short-form series that puts the SE in the hands of real artists in real rooms. I led the creative treatment and directed the US shoots on location, running photography, lighting, and the thumbnail packaging, supervising scripts, and shaping the video treatment with our videographers and editors. It gave the audience a reason to come back and turned a one-week announcement into an ongoing story.

blocks.p: The long-form film was recommended organically by YouTube to most of the people who watched it, rather than pushed there by paid spend. The underlying rates are PreSonus data and are not published here.

blocks.sub: Alongside the social system, I designed the dealer infographics that translated the SE feature set into sales tools for the retail channel.

p: A single creative lead carried the SE launch from pitch to delivery: film, photography, sound, social, and collateral all speaking one language. Launch day outperformed the preceding three-month average, the trade press picked it up widely, and the SOUNDCHECK series kept the console in front of the audience long after announcement week.
